verdict.rationale: Bulk operations across many items is a fair question for a workflow automation tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of batch or bulk item processing (such as looping over items or batch splitting). Community remarks about arrays, high workflow volume, or writing scraped posts to a spreadsheet are adjacent and do not document a bulk-operations capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
